clips.send: China’s resistance began with Japan’s invasion of northeast China in 1931. Full-scale war began in 1937. In Shanghai, refugees waited to leave. The war ended in 1945. Estimates vary. clips.send: In June 1914 two shots on a street in Sarajevo pulled every great power in Europe into war within six weeks. Barely 21 years later an even bigger war began — at the Marco Polo Bridge in China and on the border of Poland — and roughly 70 million people or more died. Why did the alliances fall like dominoes? And why did the Western Front barely move for four years?
clips.text: In June 1914 two shots on a street in Sarajevo pulled every great power in Europe into war within six weeks. Barely 21 years later an even bigger war began — at the Marco Polo Bridge in China and on the border of Poland — and roughly 70 million people or more died. Why did the alliances fall like dominoes? And why did the Western Front barely move for four years?

clips.send: In December 1937, after capturing Nanjing, Japanese troops carried out a massacre lasting about six weeks; China’s official figure and textbooks give more than 300,000 Chinese victims (the Tokyo war-crimes tribunal found over 200,000).

clips.send: The Holocaust was Nazi Germany’s planned, state-run genocide: about 6 million Jewish people were murdered, along with millions of others, including Roma, disabled people and political prisoners. Auschwitz-Birkenau, the largest death camp, was liberated by the Soviet Red Army in January 1945.

clips.send: 大屠杀（Holocaust）是纳粹德国有计划、由国家组织的种族灭绝：约600万犹太人被杀害，还有罗姆人、残障人士、政治犯等数百万人遇害。奥斯维辛、比克瑙是最大的死亡集中营，1945年1月被苏联红军解放。
